as_told.title: Errors in Epstein's Bannon interview about the Santa Fe Institute and quarks

plain: The mathematician Eric Weinstein says a taped interview that Steve Bannon did with Jeffrey Epstein shows Epstein half-repeating things he had picked up from people who really knew what they were talking about. Weinstein points to Epstein's errors. On the tape Epstein says he founded the Santa Fe Institute, a science research center, in 1990 to 93, though others founded it in 1984. He also gets something wrong about quarks and the physicist Murray Gell-Mann. To Weinstein the mistakes are a garbled echo of real conversations, which would mean Epstein moved among people with serious inside knowledge.
